anchor_note: All frames cropped by the same (12,16) offset from 288px cells without resampling. Shared root (132,178). Draw center x-4 when facing right, x+4 when flipped; y+50.
air_state_policy: Play jump_start once; rise/apex/fall hold their last frame until physics changes state; land is cancellable. jump_preview is only a visual review sequence.
dash_policy: An animation must never delay the gameplay dash; input starts velocity immediately. All frames are cancellable. Recovery is optional.

render_config.notes: Size corrections already baked into pixels. Common 256px cells, anchor (132,178). No per-action corrections. Cropped without scaling from 288px version.
